name: product_sign
description: Determine positive/negative sign of an integer product, with matched numeric operand-copy control.
generator_code:
import random,json
random.seed(0)
items=[];control=[]
for i in range(120):
 a=random.randint(1,99)*random.choice([-1,1]);b=random.randint(1,99)*random.choice([-1,1])
 items.append({'prompt':f'The product ({a}) * ({b}) is positive or negative? Answer:', 'answer':' '+('positive' if a*b>0 else 'negative')})
 control.append({'prompt':f'The product ({a}) * ({b}) has which first operand? Answer:', 'answer':' '+str(a)})
json.dump({'items':items,'control':control},open('/work/skill.json','w'))
